subject: Renewal discussion: Opal Analytics — term structure, billing buckets, co-terming
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@opal-analytics.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@opal-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion: Opal Analytics — term structure, billing buckets, co-terming

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a few structured options for your renewal that address the co-terming and phased ramp you asked about. High level:

- Option A: 12-month, tiered commit with three quarterly billing buckets (front-loaded credits available).
- Option B: 24-month, graduated ramp (30% Year 1 / 70% Year 2) with a fixed per-token floor and annual reset.
- Option C: 12-month with monthly true-up + optional auto-renew at a discounted rate.

I've attached an Excel with illustrative numbers and invoice timing permutations (Opal_Renewal_Billing_Scenarios.xlsx). Two items I flagged for your team: co-terming to your contract anniversary (Sep 1) will require a short pro-rated bridge invoice if we begin immediately, and we can include a small onboarding credit if you commit to a 24-month ramp.

Next steps: pick 1–2 preferred options and we can circulate a single tracked amendment for legal to review. Would you be available for a 30-min sync on Wed (6/23) to finalize?

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
[Attachment: Opal_Renewal_Billing_Scenarios.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@opal-analytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@opal-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: Opal Analytics — term structure, billing buckets, co-terming

Laura —

Appreciate this, the spreadsheet was helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) We like the Year 1 smaller commit + Year 2 scale (Option B) but would prefer the ramp concentrated as 40% / 60% (not 30/70).
2) Can you split invoicing so that core platform commit is annual but additional burst/overage invoices are monthly? Our finance team needs predictable annual spend for budgeting but operational teams want monthly visibility.
3) On co-terming: Sep 1 co-term is ideal; we want the new term to align with our fiscal year. If we start service July 1, can Redwood provide a prorated invoice to bridge to Sep 1?

Also looping Daniel Park (procurement) on the thread — he will take point on PO timing and tax info.

Thanks,
Sophie
Director of ML Platforms, Opal Analytics
Sophie.Nguyen@opal-analytics.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@opal-analytics.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@opal-analytics.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@opal-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion: Opal Analytics — term structure, billing buckets, co-terming

Marissa/Vivek —

Customer prefers Option B with a 40/60 split and asks for: annual invoice for committed core capacity + monthly invoices for overages; co-term to Sep 1 with a prorated bridge starting Jul 1. Can you confirm feasibility on pricing and whether we can provide a $10k onboarding credit tied to a 24-month commitment? Also, legal has historically asked for one tracked amendment when co-terming — is there anything special to flag here given Opal's data residency needs?

Sophie and Tom, internal folks will propose the formal amendment language.

Laura

Date: 2026-06-22T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: Opal Analytics — term structure, billing buckets, co-terming

Laura —

Quick answers after reviewing with finance and legal:

- 40/60 ramp (Year1/Year2) is fine. Pricing model preserved; we will set Year 1 at 60% of the Year 2 per-unit rate but keep a fixed floor to protect unit economics.
- We can split invoices: one annual invoice for the committed units (sent on Sep 1 each year) + monthly statements for overages. Overages are billed at the monthly rate in the spreadsheet.
- For co-terming: we will issue a prorated bridge invoice for Jul 1–Aug 31 (prorated to the committed annual amount) and then switch to the Sep 1 co-term.
- $10k onboarding credit: approved for a 24-month committed term. The credit will be applied as a one-time invoice credit on the bridge invoice.
- Legal: standard amendment with co-terming language; need Opal's PO number and billing address for the amendment. No special data residency clauses required beyond what’s in the existing SOW.

I've attached a draft amendment template and a clean pricing summary for execution.

Marissa Cole
Senior Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Amendment_Draft.docx (docx)]
From: Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@opal-analytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@opal-analytics.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@opal-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: Opal Analytics — term structure, billing buckets, co-terming

Thanks Marissa — this all looks good. A couple of small asks from finance/ procurement:

- Can the bridge invoice be split into two monthly invoices (Jul and Aug) rather than one lump sum for internal reporting?
- We will provide the PO and billing address by Monday (6/29).
- Small ask from execs: any chance of a $5k additional credit if we confirm purchase order by 6/30? They want the buy-in to land this quarter.

If we can do Jul/Aug split and the additional $5k, we can sign the amendment and submit the PO next week.

— Sophie

Sophie —

Great — we can split the bridge into two invoices (Jul + Aug). Marissa confirmed the $10k onboarding credit for the 24-month commit; I checked with finance and we can add an extra $5k one-time execution credit if Opal confirms PO by 6/30.

Next steps I will take:
- Update the amendment to reflect 40/60 ramp, annual committed invoice + monthly overages, Jul/Aug bridge invoices, and the two credits (one applied on bridge, one on first annual invoice).
- Circulate the tracked amendment for Opal legal and procurement to sign. (Attachment: Signed_SN_Clean.pdf will be the final signed S/N once executed.)
- Finance will prepare two draft invoices for Jul and Aug so you have them for your reporting.

Can everyone confirm by end of day 6/30 and I will get the amendment out immediately.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
